entries.purpose: 20 lossless chunks of the paginated S3 object inventory
ordered reconstruction of 790 S3 objects: six staged source assets and 784 factor-base producer snapshots
maps 784 content-addressed S3 object path hashes to expected logical output paths, bytes and SHA-256
recovery mapping for the 784 original output files plus reconstructed manifest.sha256
400 downloaded non-compressed producer output files restored under their original relative paths and SHA-256 checked
deterministic sha256sum manifest rebuilt from the 784 source object hashes
seven key producer artifacts plus reconstructed manifest copy
documented producer output tree, path hashing, and content hash contract
terminal log endpoint readback (empty after pod expiration)
reproducible path recovery and payload verification

excluded_payloads: 384 compressed .bin.zst shards remain in original attempt-01 S3 prefix; recovered index maps them and each key SHA/size matches the corresponding family manifest.
